name: Trick-or-Treat Temp
title: Candy Collections
flavor: Asks every soul for candy. Files the wrappers.

name: Bat Courier
title: Night Mail
flavor: Delivers upside down. Signs upside down.

name: Witch of Accounts Payable
title: Cauldron Budgeting
flavor: Every spreadsheet is a spell. Every spell balances.

name: The Great Pumpkin
title: Chief Financial Officer
flavor: Rises once a year to sign the budget. Never misses.

name: Gingerbread Intern
title: Freshly Baked
flavor: Run, run, as fast as the forms allow.

name: Caroling Cherub
title: Seasonal Morale
flavor: Sings the filing code. All of it.

name: Nutcracker Guard
title: Front Desk Security
flavor: Cracks cases. And walnuts.

name: Krampus
title: Director of Consequences
flavor: Keeps the naughty list. Laminated.

name: Confetti Clerk
title: Celebration Intake
flavor: Throws confetti at every approved form.

name: Countdown Officer
title: Timekeeping
flavor: Ten. Nine. Please take a number.

name: Champagne Auditor
title: Bubbles and Balances
flavor: Pops a cork for every closed ledger.

name: Father Time
title: Chief Scheduling Officer
flavor: The deadline. The original.

name: Rose Runner
title: Flower Deliveries
flavor: Every rose comes with a receipt.

name: Lovebird Pair
title: Joint Filing
flavor: Only sign forms together.

name: Sonnet Scribe
title: Romantic Correspondence
flavor: Writes rejection letters in iambic pentameter.

name: Cupid Prime
title: Head of Matchmaking
flavor: Never misses. Has a spreadsheet for it.

name: Basket Weaver
title: Egg Logistics
flavor: Every basket counted twice.

name: Egg Hunter
title: Lost Property
flavor: Finds anything. Mostly eggs.

name: Spring Gardener
title: New Beginnings
flavor: Plants a form. A soul grows.

name: The Phoenix
title: Director of Returns
flavor: Burned out. Came back. Burned out again.

name: Sandcastle Clerk
title: Temporary Structures
flavor: Builds an archive. The tide files it.

name: Ice Cream Imp
title: Morale (Melting)
flavor: Hands out cones. Collects sticky forms.

name: Ferry Captain
title: Soul Transport
flavor: Ferries souls across. Charges a coin.

name: Poseidon
title: Head of Water Damage
flavor: Every flood is technically his department.

name: Soul Wrangler
title: Hallway recovery
flavor: Lassoes loose souls with a rope of red tape. Yee-haw, in triplicate.

name: Cabinet Mimic
title: Reformed filing cabinet
flavor: Used to eat interns. Now only eats paperwork. Mostly.

name: Hall Monitor Ghost
title: Corridor patrol
flavor: Has a whistle, a sash and absolutely no authority.

name: The Backlog Baron
title: Chief of Pending Items
flavor: A tower of folders in a paper crown. Every decree is stapled in triplicate.

name: Receipt Goblin
title: Expense hoarder
flavor: Keeps every receipt. Every one. Since 1342.

name: Abacus Ghost
title: Old-school accountant
flavor: Refuses to use a calculator. Faster anyway.

name: Deduction Owl
title: Night auditor
flavor: Who? Who claimed a horse as a dependant?

name: Chief Deduction Officer
title: Head of Write-Offs
flavor: Itemizes everything, including your sighs. Counts them as a business expense.

name: Backwards Clerk
title: Reverse filing
flavor: Shirt on backwards, walks backwards, files forwards. Usually.

name: Astro-Intern
title: Star chart reader
flavor: Blames everything on the planets. Is often right.

name: Little Mercury
title: The actual planet
flavor: Sorry about all this. Brought snacks.

name: The Retrograde Oracle
title: Head of Cosmic Delays
flavor: Sees all your future paperwork. All of it is delayed.

name: Sock Puppet Clerk
title: Odd sock liaison
flavor: Speaks for socks who cannot speak. Voice is a bit much.

name: Laundry Golem
title: Basket of everything
flavor: Made entirely of lost laundry. Smells of fabric softener.

name: Lint Sprite
title: Dryer-vent spirit
flavor: Small, fluffy, everywhere. Sneezes are a hazard.

name: The Sock Sovereign
title: Ruler of the Odd Ones
flavor: Wears one crown and zero matching pairs. Rules fairly, if sideways.

name: Exorcist Intern
title: Holy toner splasher
flavor: Armed with a spray bottle of holy water and a can-do attitude.

name: Possessed Printer
title: Reformed demon device
flavor: PC LOAD LETTER. It knows what it did.

name: Paper Jam Poltergeist
title: Jam specialist
flavor: Lives inside tray 2. Rattles when it is happy.

name: The Toner Bishop
title: Keeper of the Sacred Cartridge
flavor: Blesses each jam with a swing of the censer. The paper still jams, but peacefully.

name: Aloha Reaper
title: Business-casual death
flavor: Swapped the robe for a flower shirt. Kept the scythe.

name: Flip-Flop Angel
title: Relaxed seraph
flavor: Halo tilted at a jaunty angle. Wings in sunscreen.

name: Smoothie Demon
title: Break-room barista
flavor: Blends anything into a smoothie. Do not ask what is in the green one.

name: The Weekend Executive
title: Chief Relaxation Officer
flavor: Holds every meeting from a pool float. Quarterly targets are mostly vibes.

name: Valkyrie Usher
title: Seat assignments
flavor: Flies every fallen warrior to the right bench. Clipboard is also a shield.

name: Mead Hall Steward
title: Horn-tray server
flavor: Horned helmet, endless drinking horn, perfect posture.

name: Raven Messenger
title: Odin's mail desk
flavor: Remembers everything. Will tell everyone.

name: Allfather of Accounts
title: All-Seeing Auditor
flavor: Lost an eye to a rounding error. Worth it for the ledger.

name: Peacock Clerk
title: Very important bird
flavor: Fans its tail at every form. The forms are not impressed.

name: Mirror Imp
title: Reflection services
flavor: Carries a hand mirror so souls can admire themselves while queueing.

name: Lion Notary
title: King of the stamp
flavor: Wears a tiny crown. Stamps with great dignity.

name: Lucien the Magnificent
title: Vice President of Reflection
flavor: Fell from heaven mostly to check the lighting. Looks great doing it.

name: Coin Goblin
title: Pocket inspector
flavor: Checks every pocket for coins souls try to sneak through.

name: Piggy Bank Clerk
title: Deposits only
flavor: Accepts all coins. Returns none.

name: Treasurer Dragon
title: Hoard management
flavor: Sleeps on the confiscated gold. Calls it filing.

name: The Gilded Comptroller
title: Keeper of the Vault
flavor: Sits on the coins to keep them warm. Has never once lent a penny.

name: Extinguisher Imp
title: Fire response
flavor: Puts out tempers and desks. Mostly desks.

name: Calm Coach
title: Anger management
flavor: Breathe in. Breathe out. Fill in form 12-C.

name: Kettle-Head Clerk
title: Steam vent
flavor: Whistles when angry. Whistles a lot.

name: The Fury Supervisor
title: Head of Escalations
flavor: Erupts at 9:00 sharp. Cools down by lunch, then does it again.

name: Green-Eyed Cat
title: Comparison desk
flavor: Wants whatever is on your desk. Especially the sunny spot.

name: Copycat Chameleon
title: Form duplicator
flavor: Copies every stamp it sees. Changes colour to match.

name: Lawn Clerk
title: Greener-grass inspector
flavor: Measures the grass on the other side. It is the same grass.

name: The Green Monitor
title: Director of Comparisons
flavor: Sees what you got. Wants it. Files a request in triplicate.

name: Snack Cart Ghoul
title: Trolley service
flavor: Pushes the snack cart. Eats the snack cart.

name: Fridge Slime
title: Break-room inspector
flavor: Found in the fridge. Is now staff. Nobody remembers hiring it.

name: Pie Chart Chef
title: Data catering
flavor: Bakes the quarterly reports. Literally.

name: The Bottomless CFO
title: Chief Feasting Officer
flavor: Budget meetings run on snacks. The snacks are never in the budget.

name: Sloth Clerk
title: Very slow lane
flavor: Has stamped one form since Monday. Beautifully.

name: Pillow Courier
title: Nap delivery
flavor: Delivers pillows to the queue. Making things worse.

name: Snooze Clock
title: Alarm on strike
flavor: Rings every nine minutes, then says never mind.

name: The Eternal Napper
title: Executive of Deferred Tasks
flavor: Approves everything in his sleep. Somehow it is the fastest sign-off in the building.

name: Cupid Compliance
title: HR liaison
flavor: Shoots arrows at forms that are getting too friendly.

name: Heart-Eyed Intern
title: Form enthusiast
flavor: Has never been this excited about a stapler. HR has notes.

name: Rose Stamp Clerk
title: Romantic stamping
flavor: Every approval comes with a rose-shaped stamp and a sigh.

name: The Heart Auditor
title: Manager of Affairs
flavor: Reviews every attachment with great care. Always signs with a rose.
